name: Media
summary: An image, video, audio clip, gallery or QR code supplied by the host.

src.description: Image, video or audio reference in host data; generated UI never contains URLs

alt.description: Required unless decorative. For a gallery it names the set; for a QR code it says what the code opens

kind.description: 'video' and 'audio' play with native controls; 'gallery' is several images from 'items'; 'qr' encodes 'value' as a QR code

poster.description: For 'video': media reference for the frame shown before play

transcript.description: For 'video' and 'audio': the words, offered under the player

items.description: For 'gallery': array of images in host data

imagePath.description: For 'gallery': relative path in each item to its image reference

altPath.description: For 'gallery': relative path in each item to its alt text

value.description: For 'qr': the text encoded, e.g. a payment link from host data

whenToUse: Photos or illustrations that help identify something (a product, a place, a person)
A recording people play, or a code they scan

accessibility.role: img (video / audio players, list for a gallery)
requirements: Has alt text unless decorative (then hidden from assistive technology)
Video and audio have native controls and offer a transcript
A QR code's alt says what scanning it does

agent: Reads the alt text; a gallery's images by their own alt text; a QR code's value.
rendering: Images never convey information that is not also in text
'video' shows 'poster' until played; 'audio' is a compact player; both put 'transcript' under a disclosure
'gallery' is a grid of the items' images, each with its own alt text
'qr' is drawn on a canvas at a size that scans from a phone, with the alt as its accessible name
a2ui: Image (video, audio and gallery export as Image + Text; a QR code as Text of its value)
